items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions Tom Hurley as a conductor who worked with Fats Waller and Duke Ellington, but there is no statement from Joe Thomas indicating a personal connection, meeting, or collaboration with Hurley.

ctx.x: Well, Fats was a tremendous musician, as you know. And, during the rehearsal he'd get the shows together and to lead the shows off, there's afellow that's a conductor there that by the name of Tom Hurley.
